changelog:
- Initial release of hackernews-cn skill.
- Get top, new, and best Hacker News stories, including Ask HN, Show HN, and jobs.
- Analyze story trends, comment summaries, and monitor keywords.
- Supports data from Hacker News Official API and Algolia HN Search API.
- Simple Chinese commands to filter, search, and display stories with ranking, points, and comments.
